A '''false touch ''' was an anti-security device used to simulate the bioelectrical field and fingerprint of an individual in order to overcome a touchprint lock. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used a false touch as well as a [[False eye/Legends|false eye]].<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
